title: Vignette 2026-11-04: can we trust writes to the shared server when main is not writeable?

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
now that we have our srs mcp with shared repos, we should probably think a bit about what repos it actually points to and how they stay up to date. 
Ideally we should be able to trust our writes to the mcp. But how does this work for branches where main is not writeable? How do we keep in sync? 
Clerk service?
